name: Alphalete - Baseline SEO and AI Report 2026-07-09
body:
> Report · Alphalete · 2026-07-09

# Summary
The first baseline report, built from Search Atlas data pulled Jul 9 2026 (GSC, GBP, rank tracker, local heat map, LLM visibility). It sets the zero point before SEO, GEO, AEO and AI work, proposes a report layout, and lists the setup tasks done Jul 7 to 9. GA4 was not yet connected in Search Atlas.

# Baseline numbers
- **GSC (90 days, Apr 9 to Jul 6):** 43 clicks (US 34), 4,377 impressions (US 4,277), CTR about 0.98% (0.79% US), US average position 32.9.
- Top queries: trenchless sewer repair (389 impr, position about 54), trenchless sewer (78), alphalete (67), pipe lining near me (49, position 1).
- Top pages: `/what-is-trenchless-sewer-repair/` (1,183 impr, position 51), homepage (587, 28), `/hydro-jetting-colorado-springs/` (108, 17).
- **GBP:** score 56, 52.4% complete, **not verified**, 16 reviews (4.94 average), 0 replies, 0 citations; views, calls and directions not flowing.
- **Local heat map:** 1 keyword tracked, baseline average map rank 21 (Jul 8).
- **AI visibility:** 1.7% overall, sentiment 74, 83 mentions; ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Mode all 0%. 5 topics / 15 queries tracked from Jul 7.

# Recommended report layout
Executive summary, AI/SEO score overview, keyword ranking progress, local heat map, GBP performance, GA4 traffic, GSC performance, completed tasks, issues fixed, next steps.

# Open issues listed (all Pending at the time)
GBP not verified (high); 0 of 16 reviews replied (high); core keywords rank deep (high); GA4 not connected (high); very low AI visibility (medium); 0 citations (medium); profile 52% complete (medium); rank tracker location set to United States instead of Colorado Springs (low).
